treaty_name: Convention between Ireland and the Hellenic Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2003)
eif_quote: (from treaties_merged.json; Revenue country listing) Tax treaties by country (A-Z): Greece

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed: a. 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends;
b. 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the law of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: 5% dividend tier requires direct holding of >=25% of VOTING POWER. MLI Art. 8 does not apply: Greece reserved the entirety of Art. 8 (Greece MLI position: "Pursuant to Article 8(3)(a) of the Convention, the Hellenic Republic reserves the right for the entirety of Article 8 not to apply to its Covered Tax Agreements"). No Revenue synthesised text for Greece; PPT quote is MLI Art. 7(1) as reproduced in Revenue synthesised texts; covered status and WHT effective date (1 Jan 2022) from treaties_merged.json. valid_from = 1 Jan of year after EIF per Art. 29.
